PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE Technology Lead | Knowext Inc., Montreal, Canada - Remote September 2023 – Present

backend development, APIs, database operations, and application workflows.
• Optimized SQL queries, API logic, and data workflows and supported end-to-end SDLC activities.

Participated in Agile sprints and delivered iterative production improvements.

raw_sections.projects:
KEY PROJECTS AI ENGINEERING & GENERATIVE AI PROJECTS Python | FastAPI | React/Next.js | LLMs | Ollama | OpenAI API | REST APIs | Git/GitHub
